Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly ONE production inventory item sprite for the Minecraft RPG plugin Evergarden Forge.
Reference image 1 provides ONLY the established pixel-art rendering language: strong square pixel clusters, jewel-like highlights, dark colored edge pixels and broad crisp facets. Do not copy its red flame silhouette unless the requested subject is fire.
Style: carefully authored 64x64 logical-pixel fantasy RPG sprite, enlarged with nearest-neighbor-like edges. Flat stepped color ramps, broad deliberate pixel clusters and a few large readable facets. Keep the characteristic identity and element-specific silhouette; differentiate quality through actual cut, completeness and clarity, not badges or color recoloring.

Asset type: final small inventory sprite, one FIRE GEM.
Input image 1 is the edit target.
Keep the fiery ruby gemstone idea, orange/garnet palette, broad faceted body, and flame-shaped pointed silhouette.
Change the rendering to authentic low-resolution 32x32 pixel art, displayed enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling. One gem only, centered in a square canvas. Transparent background with real alpha. No text, runes, UI, detached particles, extra gemstones, ground shadow, frame, or drawn checkerboard. Preserve the distinctive broad ruby body rather than turning it into an ordinary flame.
